programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970; the group's UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

programme.title: Annie Lennox - An Evening of Nostalgia
programme.desc: An Evening Of Nostalgia with Annie Lennox captures one of music's most popular and acclaimed artists in her only full concert performance of songs from her Grammy-nominated Nostalgia album.

programme.title: John Denver - Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan is a 1981 concert from John Denver's 7-show tour of Japan and features a wonderful selection of hits from his career, including: Annie's Song, Calypso, Sunshine On My Shoulders & Thank God I'm A Country Boy.

programme.title: Supertramp: Breakfast In America: Live in Paris
programme.desc: Supertramp's Breakfast In America was the biggest selling album in the world in 1979. Following the album's release Supertramp embarked on a 10-month world tour which arrived in Paris at the end of November.

programme.title: Toto - Falling In Between
programme.desc: This concert was recorded at Le Zenith in Paris in March 2007 in front of a wildly enthusiastic sell-out crowd. It captures Toto rocking at their hardest and most powerful and giving a new life to all their best loved tracks.

programme.title: Bachman & Turner - Live
programme.desc: Randy Bachman and C.F. Fred Turner were the core members of Bachman-Turner Overdrive throughout their commercial heyday in the seventies, sharing duties on the lead vocals with Bachman contributing lead guitar and Turner the bass.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette - Live at Montreux 2012
programme.desc: On 2 July 2012 Alanis Morissette returned to Montreux as part of her Guardian Angel Tour. The set showcased a number of tracks from the new album alongside classic tracks from across her career. Music video by Alanis Morissette © 2012 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: The Police: Around the World
programme.desc: During 1977-1981, The Police went on a global tour which took them through more than a dozen countries, including many that most rock bands of the period would fail to reach.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers - Live At Wolf Trap
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, Live At Wolf Trap captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks.

programme.title: Pixies Electric: Club Date live in Boston
programme.desc: Legendary alternative rock band The Pixies perform their greatest hits including 'Alison', 'Bone Machine', 'Bad Punk' and classic 'Where is My Mind' in an intimate setting in Boston.

programme.title: Scorpions - Forever And A Day: Live In Munich
programme.desc: After 50 years on stages all around the world, Germany's Scorpions decided it was time to embark on one last tour. This fully authorized documentary follows the hard rockers from their beginnings as young music fans to the present day.

programme.title: Heart - Live At The Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: This film captures not only Heart's first-ever live performance at the Royal Albert Hall but is also the first concert film of Heart performing with a full orchestra.

programme.title: The Black Keys - Live at Main Square Festival
programme.desc: Main Square Festival is a music festival that takes place in Arras, France, lasting three days.

programme.title: Qello Concerts' Best
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: Soundgarden - Live in London 2014
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Alabama Shakes - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: Mixing classic R&B vocals with a soulful blues-rock base, Alabama Shakes have taken garage rock and turned it on its head. Alabama Shakes takes the Austin City Limits stage for the second time in support of their newest album Sound & Color.

programme.title: Andrea Bocelli: Live in Tuscany
programme.desc: Vivere: Live in Tuscany is a concert performed by classical singer Andrea Bocelli.

programme.title: Annie Lennox - An Evening of Nostalgia
programme.desc: An Evening Of Nostalgia with Annie Lennox captures one of music's most popular and acclaimed artists in her only full concert performance of songs from her Grammy-nominated Nostalgia album.

programme.title: Alice in Chains - Unplugged
programme.desc: In their first live concert in over 2 years (and possibly their last concert ever), Alternative/metal group Alice in Chains performs acoustically at MTV Unplugged. Includes acoustic versions of their hits.

programme.title: Willie Nelson - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Johnny Cash: Live at Montreux 1994
programme.desc: This classic concert features favorites like Folsom Prison Blues, I Walk the Line and Ghost Riders in the Sky. Cash welcome his wife June Carter Cash on two tracks.

programme.title: Various Artists - Legends of Rock and Roll
programme.desc: Filmed in Rome in 1989, this once-in-a-lifetime live performance features some of the most legendary performers in rock n' roll history, including B.B. King, Jerry Lee Lewis, Bo Diddley, Little Richard, Fats Domino, Ray Charles, and James Brown.

programme.title: Rush - Time Machine: Live in Cleveland
programme.desc: Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures,' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centerpiece of the concerts.

programme.title: John Mellencamp - Plain Spoken: Live in Chicago
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation.

programme.title: The Moody Blues - Days of Future Passed Live
programme.desc: This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance the album Days of Future Passed.

programme.title: Alabama & Friends - Live at the Ryman
programme.desc: Join superstar band Alabama, recorded at the historic Ryman Auditorium, featuring on stage collaborations with country's biggest stars: Luke Bryan, Jason Aldean, Trisha Yearwood, Florida Georgia Line, Jamey Johnson and the Eli Young Band.

programme.title: Willie Nelson - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Journey - Live in Manila
programme.desc: On March 14, 2009, Journey returned to Arnel Pineda's homeland and introduced him as their newest lead singer to a crowd of nearly 30,000 at the SM Mall of Asia Concert Grounds. Features songs such as Don't Stop Believin', Stone In Love, When You Love A Woman and Separate Ways.

programme.title: Ed Sheeran -- Live in London
programme.desc: Ed Sheeran makes a large venue feel intimate; with his guitar and vocal skills, Sheeran delivers a strong performance in 2014 at the Roundhouse Art Center in London.

programme.title: The Cure - Eurockéennes 2012
programme.desc: The legendary rock band The Cure hits the stage at Eurockéennes in Belfort, in 2012.

programme.title: 2CELLOS - Live in London 2011
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Yes - Songs From Tsongas 35th Anniversary
programme.desc: Songs From Tsongas is a live performance from Yes' 35th Anniversary Tour in 2004, the last tour by the band to feature the classic line-up of Jon Anderson, Steve Howe, Chris Squire, Rick Wakeman and Alan White.

programme.title: Ziggy Marley - Live at the Filmore
programme.desc: The Fillmore Auditorium is a historic concert hall in San Francisco, California. Founded by Bill Graham, it was named after being located originally on the corners of Fillmore Street and Geary Boulevard.

programme.title: Carlos Santana - Greatest Hits: Live at Montreux 2011
programme.desc: Masterfully filmed in Montreux in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classics hits such as Jingo, Evil Ways and Black Magic Woman their later No.1 hits Maria, Maria and Smooth. Music video by Carlos Santana __© 2011 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall.

programme.title: Scorpions - Forever And A Day: Live In Munich
programme.desc: After 50 years on stages all around the world, Germany's Scorpions decided it was time to embark on one last tour. This fully authorized documentary follows the hard rockers from their beginnings as young music fans to the present day.

programme.title: The Jimi Hendrix Experience - Miami Pop Festival
programme.desc: Spotlighting the Jimi Hendrix Experience's appearance at the Miami Pop Festival in 1968, this invaluable documentary features performance footage, home movies, interviews and more.

programme.title: Peter Gabriel - Secret World: Live
programme.desc: Filmed in Modena, Italy across two nights in November 1993 as part of Peter Gabriel's acclaimed Secret World Live tour in support of the Us album.

programme.title: The Dream Children
programme.desc: Alex wants to become a father. Steven, his partner, has to confront his insecurities and fear of change after a lifetime smothered by superficiality. Unable to adopt legally, but still eager to become parents, they decide to turn to the black market, adopting a child from a desperate young woman, who's return with a dangerous new boyfriend, threatens to destroy everything they love.

programme.title: Animals
programme.desc: A sexually confused teen finds solace with his wise-cracking pet bear but everything changes when he falls in love.

programme.title: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: A Brother in the Catholic Church must choose between his vow of chastity and the man he loves.

programme.title: Cherry Grove Stories
programme.desc: CHERRY GROVE STORIES recounts the unique character of Cherry Grove, a community on Fire Island, New York.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.desc: Daniel and Christopher have to rely on their close friends and families to help them through drama on the eve of their wedding.

programme.title: SAMURAI MARATHON [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In 1855, a daimyo sends his men on a grueling marathon to discover if they're tough enough to face the newly arrived Americans. Misunderstanding his intent, the Shogun dispatches assassins.

programme.title: 11 REBELS [English Dub]
programme.desc: Amidst the Boshin War's brutal conflicts, a motley squad of criminals and samurai undertakes a desperate defense of a fortress, their stand triggered by clashing interests of the Shibata clan, the shogunate, and the new government.

programme.title: GINTAMA [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In an era where aliens have invaded and conquered feudal Tokyo, a young samurai seeks work as he can.

programme.title: Inside Men [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A politician and a wealthy CEO scheme with a reputable journalist to create slush fund and to manipulate public opinion. They use Ahn Sang-gu, a gangster deeply involved in politics, to manage their slush fund, but Ahn Sang-gu gets caught and as a result is abandoned. Sang-gu is bent on having his revenge. On the other hand, Woo Jang-hoon, a prosecutor without any powerful friends, is desperate to solve the slush fund case so he can get a promotion.

programme.title: The Man Standing Next [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: October 26th, 1979, Kim Gyu-pyeong, the director of KCIA, shoots President Park at his safe house. Forty days before the incident, Park Yong-gak, the former KCIA director, disclose the president's corruption. The Pres. wants to "take care of" Park after discovering he wrote a memoir, and Kim volunteers to persuade him. Kim asks Park to hand over the documents and asks forgiveness, but Park refuses, saying, "He doesn't let the No. 2 alive." Kwak Sang-chun, the head of the president's security team, expresses his loyalty to the president excessively, which makes the conflict between Kwak and Kim. When the memoir publishes in Japan, the president reprimands Kim. Kim executes a mission that proves his loyalty to the president, but the president's trust falters more.

programme.title: A Man of Reason [English Dub]
programme.desc: After 10 years in the prison on behalf of his boss, Soo-hyuk is released, but the boss doubts his loyalty. When Soo-hyuk visits his long-abandoned girlfriend, he finds out that he, now, is a father of young girl. He wants to cut ties with the gang, but the boss is not ready to release him, and hires a notorious killer. The killer takes the daughter as hostage, and Soo-hyuk decides to take revenge in a way that he's best at; violence.

programme.title: The Divine Fury [English Dub]
programme.desc: Champion fighter Yong-hu seeks aid from a priest when strange wounds appear on his palms, leading to a battle against evil.

programme.title: HARBIN [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In 1909, a Korean freedom fighter plots to assassinate Japan's prime minister on a train journey to Harbin, seeking redemption for his fallen squad.

programme.title: Lost In Thailand [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The film is about three Chinese men traveling in Thailand: two competing scientists searching for their boss, and a tourist eager to explore the country.

programme.title: KUNG FU KILLER [English Dub]
programme.desc: A martial arts instructor from the police force gets imprisoned after killing a man by accident. But when a vicious killer starts targeting martial arts masters, the instructor offers to help the police in return for his freedom.

programme.title: Escape from the 21st Century [English Dub]
programme.desc: The story follows three friends who discover they have the power to travel back and forth 20 years with a sneeze. However, the future is not as good as they hoped, and they need to take on the responsibility of saving the world.

programme.title: FLASH POINT [English Dub]
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Ma Jun, known for dispensing his own brand of justice during arrests, teams up with an undercover cop, Wilson, to try and bring down three merciless Vietnamese brothers running a smuggling ring in the months before mainland China's takeover of Hong Kong. Jun pursues the gang tirelessly, sometimes ignoring police protocols. A showdown is inevitable!

programme.title: Exhuma [English Dub]
programme.desc: Feng shui master Kim Sang-deok joins a shaman and a mortician to relocate a cursed ancestral grave, but the excavation unearths a colonial atrocity buried beneath the soil, forcing crew into a brutal confrontation with an immortal warrior.

programme.title: Mojin: The Lost Legend [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Three grave robbers (Chen Kun, Shu Qi, Huang Bo) explore a lost underground kingdom to find a powerful charm.

programme.title: Rampant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Returning from imprisonment, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons.

programme.title: SAKURAN [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A young girl is sold into a red-light district brothel and tries to adapt to life and meke her own way as an No.1 oiran (courtesan).

programme.title: Gangnam Zombie [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Citizens from upscale Gangnam in Seoul start experiencing unusual and terrifying symptoms, devolving into inhuman creatures, leaving only a few survivors with the possibility to make it out alive.

programme.title: Be With You [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Soo-ah, who died, leaving an impossible that she’d come back when it rains, appears before Woo-jin one summer day drenched in the first rain of the monsoon season. While she doesn’t even remember him, Woo-jin is happy that she’s by his side again. As Woo-jin tells Soo-ah about their love story, the two lovers fall in love with each other all over again.

programme.title: 12.12: The Day [English Dub]
programme.desc: The movie depicts the events that occurred on the night that changed the course of South Korea's history. Following the assassination of President Park Chung-hee on October 26, 1979, the citizens of Seoul had high aspirations for the democratization of their country. However, on December 12, Army Commander Jeon Doo-kwang and his allies staged a coup to seize power. The remaining army forces, led by Capital Defense Commander Lee Tae-shin, engaged in a confrontation with the rebels, putting the fate of the country and the lives of its citizens at stake.

programme.title: Hard Hit [English Dub]
programme.desc: On his way to work, a bank manager receives an anonymous call claiming there's a bomb under his car seat, and if anyone exits the car, it will explode unless he can pay a ransom.

programme.title: ESCAPE [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Military camps near the DMZ of a divided land, where the South is the land of freedom, and the opposite side is the land of repression. Sergeant Gyu-nam, who has been planning an escape to the South for a long time, gets caught while stopping a common soldier, Dong-hyuk, from escaping. At the risk of execution, State Security Department Major Hyun-sang recognizes Gyu-nam from childhood. Instead of accusing him, Hyeon-sang decides to make Gyu-nam a hero who caught a deserter. Hyeon-sang, therefore, has succeeded in securing his performance records by saving Gyu-nam’s life. Nevertheless, Gyu-nam wants to live his life by his own will, not the government’s commands. He never gives up on crossing the border. On the other hand, Hyeon-sang desperately stops Gyu-nam to protect his life, which has been built by giving up his dream.

programme.title: Project Y [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Two women, friends and of the same age Mi Seon and Do Gyeong, might be used to struggling in the most dangerous part of Seoul's Gangnam district, but that doesn't mean they've settled into it. With no one but each other to rely on, the two friends grind away to save the money needed to leave their dangerous lifestyles behind. But just as “retirement” comes within reach, the world betrays them, shattering their hopes. On the edge of a dead end, they discover a hidden fortune of dirty cash and gold in Gangnam – and place all their bets on one final high-stakes gamble of a lifetime. They make an audacious plan to steal $6 million USD in gold bars and flee from the area.

programme.title: Hit and Run Squad [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The internal Affairs team has been disgraced while investigating a bribery case against the Police Commissioner and racer-turned-entrepreneur Jung Jae-chul. The second-in-command of the IA team, Lieutenant Eun Shi-yeon, is relegated to the Hit and Run Squad at Inchon PD. She meets Squad Captain Woo and constable Seo Min-jae, who has an instinct for cars and a delinquent past. Eun also gets acquainted with Seo's family, who have met through car accidents. A hit-and-run case leads the squad to Jung as a prime suspect, Eun conducts a separate operation to acquire the black box in Jung's concept car. Jung, a reckless speed freak, chases Eun, leading to a tragic accident costing someone's life. When Eun discovers the dirty deal behind her back, she cooperates with Seo to finally bring justice to Jung.

programme.title: TAI CHI ZERO [English Dub]
programme.desc: Yang travels to Chen Village to learn a powerful form of Tai Chi. Though villagers are forbidden from teaching outsiders, Yang becomes their best hope for survival when a man arrives with a plan to build a railroad through the village.

programme.title: TAI CHI HERO [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tai Chi Hero is a martial arts adventure story about a martial artist defending his adopted home and marriage while mastering the art of Tai Chi. Starring Jayden Yuan, Angelababy, Eddie Peng. Continuing his journey, Yang Lu Chan marries into the Chen family to learn advanced Tai Chi. Soon, he must overcome internal village suspicion and lead the defense against a powerful army armed with deadly western technology.

programme.title: KUNG FU KILLER [English Dub]
programme.desc: A martial arts instructor from the police force gets imprisoned after killing a man by accident. But when a vicious killer starts targeting martial arts masters, the instructor offers to help the police in return for his freedom.

programme.title: The Divine Fury [English Dub]
programme.desc: Champion fighter Yong-hu seeks aid from a priest when strange wounds appear on his palms, leading to a battle against evil.

programme.title: Kill-Fist [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A struggling middle-aged insurance salesman and failed family man joins an underground fight club to redeem himself. As he progresses through the fights, he finds his true potential and faces his dark past that he has forgotten.

programme.desc: A politician and a wealthy CEO scheme with a reputable journalist to create slush fund and to manipulate public opinion. programme.title: Ashfall [English Dub]
programme.desc: In the face of a disaster that will engulf both North and South Korea, a mission is put into action to stop a super volcanic eruption.

programme.title: CREATION OF THE GODS I: KINGDOM OF STORMS [English Dub]
programme.desc: Based on the most well-known classical fantasy novel of China, Fengshenyanyi, the trilogy is a magnificent eastern high fantasy epic that recreates the prolonged mythical wars between humans, immortals and monsters, which happened more than three thousand years ago.

programme.title: Ransomed [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: In 1987, a diplomat who had disappeared in Lebanon 20 months earlier sent a coded message announcing his survival. Min-joon, a diplomat in charge of Middle East affairs, volunteered for an unofficial operation to rescue his colleague, hoping to be posted to the United States if successful. After arriving at the airport, Min-joon got into the car of Pan-soo, a Korean taxi driver, to evade airport security who were trying to steal a ransom. He was chased by corrupt officials and gangs who were looking for money and didn't fully trust his only ally. Will Min-joon be able to complete the mission safely?

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Distraught when Ashley’s refuses his proposal, Craig falls into a major rage, completely trashing his hotel room. But when Ashley calls and says she’s reconsidered, Craig is elated and while at Ashley’s dad’s wedding, he announces that he and Ashley are engaged.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Degrassi has a new hottie in Grade 9 and Manny’s got her eye on him. Especially since her “boyfriend” Spinner can’t even be bothered to take a night off work to come to the Cupid Dance she’s organized.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Something’s wrong with Emma. Though she’s frustrated at being treated with kid gloves by everyone since the school shooting, she’s not sure how she’d rather be treated. So she just keeps going on, numbly reassuring everyone that she’s fine so they’ll leave her alone.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Emma steps into the lead role in Dracula, but her recent extra-curricular activities with Jay prove even more dramatic. A public health nurse has been called in as a number of students—including Jay’s girlfriend Alex-- have been diagnosed with gonorrhea.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Spinner has difficulty dealing with the return of injured Jimmy. He hasn’t talked to him since the shooting, and his guilt over what he did leaves him unable to welcome Jimmy back to school. But Jimmy wants to things to return to normal, which means having all his friends around him.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Ellie is finding it hard to make ends meet now that she’s living on her own and hates relying on her mother for rent, especially with its obligatory dinners to pick up the cheque.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Paige and Matt are totally in love, so what if they have to keep it secret? It’s worth all the extra effort. But when Manny reveals the secret during a heated fight with Paige, she learns that Matt might not be as comfortable with their relationship once it becomes public knowledge—and jeopardizes his teaching career.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: With school coming to a close, Marco is making huge plans for his summer with Dylan – and their future. He’s considering fast-tracking to graduate high school, joining Dylan in university a year earlier.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: After dutifully picking up the Spirit Squad slack for a love-struck Paige all year, Manny feels betrayed when Paige claims all the glory. So Manny plots her revenge with a complicated cheer that leaves Paige with a broken leg on Prom Night.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Ashley’s leaving for the summer, and the idea of their temporary farewell and the stress of writing a song for Kevin Smith’s movie -- is making him, well, nuts. So Craig decides to do whatever it takes to follow her, finding a summer music school program that would be perfect.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Frustrated by everything around him, Craig runs away. As he wanders the street, he befriends a young busker nicknamed, “Skinny”.

programme.desc: Mario and friends are invited to the Flower Kingdom by its ruler, Prince Florian, when Bowser suddenly appears, along with Kamek and Bowser Jr.! programme.title: Finnish Metal Special
programme.desc: From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Right Up Your Alley
programme.desc: As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- & Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

programme.title: Metal Detector
programme.desc: Look no further! This is the right place for everything heavy. Your quest has ended so, lean back, turn up that sound system to a solid 11 and enjoy the ride. You have been warned…

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: New Rock And Metal Videos For You
programme.desc: Stay ahead of the curve with the freshest drops from the global underground. From world premieres to the latest studio masterpieces, we’ve gathered the newest sonic assaults in one place. If it’s loud and new, it’s here.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: The Art of Destruction
programme.desc: Der Produzent Ilija Jelusic hat jahrelang die Band „Destruction“ begleitet.

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: Wishbone Ash - Live in London - 40th Anniversary Concert
Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: Dan Notartomaso seeks $650,000 in funding for his companies, Peak Custom Construction and Oak and Iron Design Co. As Dan unveils his unique niche in high-end home remodels catering to professional athletes, the panel of experts delve into his ambitious plans and financial challenges. With rapid growth during the pandemic, Dan grapples with cash flow issues and the need for strategic investment.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: Mother-daughter duo Tosha Wright and Lisa Dunnigan from Teach Your Heart Out seek $600,000 in funding to propel their educational conference business to new heights. With a mission to rejuvenate and empower educators nationwide, they share their inspiring journey and ambitious plans with the panel of experts. Despite facing challenges such as the impact of COVID-19 on educational conferences and the need for strategic expansion, Tosha and Lisa impress with their passion and dedication to their cause.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: Dr. Don Wood, CEO and founder of the Inspired Performance Institute, seeks funding to scale his groundbreaking trauma resolution program. With a mission to revolutionize mental health treatment, Dr. Wood's program, TIPP, boasts a remarkable 90% success rate in alleviating post-traumatic stress, anxiety, and depression. Rooted in his personal journey to save his daughter from chronic illness, Dr. Wood's method resets the mind's response to trauma, yielding rapid and lasting results in just four hours. Despite financial challenges, Dr. Wood's vision to reach millions drives his pursuit of strategic partnerships and media exposure, highlighting the transformative potential of his innovative approach to healing.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: Restaurant owner Eldridge Williams takes center stage, seeking $750,000 to propel his beloved establishment, The Delta, to new heights. With a vibrant personality and a deep passion for hospitality, Eldridge shares his journey from Memphis to Chicago, where he crafted The Delta's unique ambiance inspired by the Mississippi Delta's culture. Despite facing challenges, including the impact of COVID-19 on revenue, Eldridge's vision for scalability shines through, anchored by his signature dish, tamales.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: John and Chelsea Jubilee from Energized Health seek $1 million to grow their thriving health business. With their unique scientific protocol targeting intracellular hydration, they aim to address the root cause of illness and disease. As the panel examines the intricacies of their business, including financials and expansion plans, concerns emerge regarding the practicality of rapid scaling, leading to a concentrated discussion on optimizing cash flow and enhancing profitability within the existing framework through marketing refinement and potential subscription models.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Suffering has deep social causes. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains how your physiology is impacted by stress and social determinants.

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: The team, led by Anand, prepare for their motorcycle adventure to the four sacred peaks. The first practice ride is here in the birthplace of yoga, but it is not encouraging as monsoons are destroying roads and villages, Fred seems a liability and Ryan's seizures could be an issue.

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Jen and Jeff’s dream is to save their marriage on this journey, but it’s clear they are in different mindsets from the beginning. We are reminded that Anand himself had a prophecy of death and his teachers and life adventures helped guide him to freedom. Heading towards Kedarnath, night’s darkness sets in and Ryan sees someone Flip over their handlebars…

programme.title: Road To Dharma
programme.desc: Our first glimpse of the first peak, Kedarnath, the temple of death. Anand reminds us that What needs to die is part of the ego, fears, and comforts. Ken thinks people are riding recklessly, Mario takes his first spill, injuring his passenger Aizhan. Jeff ‘s comments further alienate Jen, but motivate her to rise up to greatness…

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo y Rebeca amanecen juntos y son sorprendidos por Coromoto y el personal doméstico. A continuación, Rebeca "abre" la situación ante todos e invita a los niños a pasar al cuarto a saludar a su padre. María Lucía se entera de que un benefactor misterioso pagó todas las cuotas de su colegiatura. Luego, al toparse con Julio en los pasillos de la universidad, él le confiesa que fue él. Irene recibe la visita de Paula en casa de Felipe y tienen una discusión tensa. Paula luego va a ver a Felipe al estudio y tergiversa los términos de la conversación. Felipe le pide que se vaya y los deje en paz. La investigación de Carlos Ernesto progresa gracias al esfuerzo de Juan Pablo, quien ha descubierto un extraño movimiento de los bienes de Rebeca mientras ella estaba supuestamente muerta.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca le hace una visita a Trinidad para dejarle la ropa de Irene y, de paso, humillarla. La mujer termina echándola de la casa prácticamente a patadas. Irene le comenta a Virginia que Felipe le ofreció ser el padre de su hijo por nacer y Virginia cuestiona la voluntad de su hermana de negarle la paternidad a Leonardo. Julio acude a casa de su abuela, Jimena, para interrogarla sobre su identidad. La mujer le da de largas y no contesta su pregunta.Juan Pablo va al motel donde Carlos Ernesto, Tony y Maribel esperan la hora de viajar al Caribe y le lleva los documentos. Por casualidad, Juan Pablo sube al auto de Carlos Ernesto y el mismo estalla en mil pedazos. Adolfo se congratula de lo bien que ha salido su plan.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela intenta salvar su matrimonio con Ricardo mientras lidia con su rechazo hacia Elizabeth y las intrigas de Katiuska. Celia descubre que está embarazada y busca retener a Ricardo, quien impide que Manuela la enfrente. Entretanto, Moisés busca la verdad sobre su padre, y Marcelo enfrenta tensiones familiares tras su separación de Graciela. En medio de conflictos y secretos, Misael muestra interés por Manuela, mientras Katiuska sigue manipulando para separar a la pareja principal.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo enfrenta el acoso de Celia, quien le oculta su embarazo, mientras Manuela investiga a Misael. Moisés busca a su padre con apoyo de Elizabeth. Entre tensiones familiares y secretos, Ricardo teme perder a Manuela tras la llegada de Graciela. Benjamín sabotea a Rebeca y Verónica intenta seducir a Marcelo sin éxito. La Nonna se enfrenta a Katiuska para proteger la relación de su nieto, mientras los conflictos por el pasado y las herencias amenazan la estabilidad de todos.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: La Nonna se enfrenta a Katiuska por intentar separar a Ricardo y Manuela. Mientras Verónica seduce a Marcelo, Celia oculta su pasado y Elizabeth revela su nuevo embarazo, lo que amenaza el matrimonio de su padre. Katiuska sigue intrigando contra la pareja, manipulando pruebas y sembrando dudas sobre la amistad de Manuela con Misael, quien confiesa su amor por ella. Ricardo descubre que Misael y Donatella están casados, mientras Graciela busca soluciones para la infertilidad de Manuela.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia confirma su embarazo de Ricardo, desatando conflictos con Manuela y Juan Marcos. Katiuska manipula a Manuela y destruye pruebas legales, mientras Graciela oculta su infertilidad y sabotea romances ajenos. Brigitte escapa de rehabilitación e intenta seducir al padre Alejandro. Entre secretos sobre el pasado de sus padres e intrigas por herencias, los personajes enfrentan traiciones y decisiones desesperadas que ponen a prueba sus relaciones.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska manipula a Ricardo mientras Moisés busca la verdad sobre su padre. Manuela defiende a Misael ante Hortensia y sospecha estar embarazada. Tras un fuerte enfrentamiento entre Graciela y Celia por Ricardo, se revela el embarazo de esta última, lo que desata las intrigas de Katiuska. Finalmente, Moisés llega a casa de Celia ignorando que es su madre, mientras Benjamín lo busca desesperadamente tras su ausencia del liceo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa y Alejandro pasan la tarde íntima en un hotel; Rosalía y Junior descubren su ausencia furiosos. Adolfo contrata un detective con Consuelo para hallar a su hija. Eustoquio golpea brutalmente a José Luis por orden de Erasto. Maricela acepta unirse a Alcohólicos Anónimos con Alberto. Adolfo va a la tienda y le exige a Consuelo despedir a Rosa para proteger a Rosalía; Consuelo se niega. Consuelo e Isaías se topan con Maricela en una sesión y descubren que ella es la mujer con la que Isaías iba cuando se accidentó.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: José Luis llega golpeado a la residencia y acusa a Erasto. Blanca, al oírlo, expulsa a Natalia al confirmarla como amante de Erasto. Arminda y Eustoquio aterrorizan a Erasto disfrazándose de Benedicto para enloquecerlo. Isaías confiesa en voz alta su alcoholismo en la sesión. Salvador confiesa a Adolfo que siempre supo de la hija perdida. Alejandro se desahoga con Gualberto, quien le aconseja dejar a Rosalía. Junior incita a Rosalía y ella jura hacer algo que impedirá que Alejandro la deje, gestando lo que será su gran mentira.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Maricela pide a Alberto que le consiga un certificado de embarazo falso. Erasto humilla a Natalia llevándola a su propia casa frente a Arminda. Blanca llega a casa de Erasto a confrontarlo, acusándolo de querer matarla para casarse con Natalia. Alejandro intenta romper con Rosalía, pero ella le muestra el certificado de embarazo falso, paralizando su decisión. Adolfo promete a Consuelo seguir buscando a su hija. Rosa cuenta a Carmen el pasado de Consuelo y su hija perdida; Carmen se desmaya conmocionada al oír la historia que toca demasiado de cerca su propia herida secreta.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro deja que Sol le tome una prueba de ADN para comprobar si es el padre de Esperanza, agregando además la condición de que ella haga esas pruebas en un laboratorio sin que él no sepa, para así no tener chance de adulterar los resultados. Luego, Sol y Alejandro se reencuentran, y aunque Alejandro insiste en no ser el padre de Esperanza, Sol le confirma que nunca ha estado con otro hombre que no sea él. Él la besa a la fuerza, pero llega Alejandrito y deben separarse.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Graciela llorando le pide disculpas a Atanasio y le dice que no lo volverá a molestar ni a él ni a su esposa. Atanasio también con los ojos enrojecidos | le pide disculpas a ella Bienvenida le dice unas cuentas cosas a Solymar por lo de Graciela Gisela comienza a hablarle a Atanasio de la gente que está en el restaurante. Atanasio obstinado le dice que se vayan y ella acepta. Segundo le dice a ROKUro que le gusta Carolina pero que ella nunca aceptará a un taxista.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Doroteo confiesa a María José que está deprimido por La Nena. Santiago defiende ferozmente a Luis Fernando y le provoca para que se decida a recuperar a un verdadero amigo. Yesenia se desmaya al escuchar la propuesta de matrimonio de Marco Aurelio.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Katiuska manipula a Ricardo mientras Moisés busca la verdad sobre su padre. Manuela defiende a Misael ante Hortensia y sospecha estar embarazada. Tras un fuerte enfrentamiento entre Graciela y Celia por Ricardo, se revela el embarazo de esta última, lo que desata las intrigas de Katiuska. Finalmente, Moisés llega a casa de Celia ignorando que es su madre, mientras Benjamín lo busca desesperadamente tras su ausencia del liceo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto cuenta a Marisela en la clínica todo sobre Consuelo y la hija perdida, incitándola a vengarse. Marisela enfrenta a Adolfo delante de Junior y Andreína, jurándolo públicamente. Alejandro entrega a Rosa los 500 mil bolívares del marcapasos. Adolfo exige a Alejandro cumplir con Rosalía. Eustoquio se queda frío: el cheque del comprador de dólares es rechazado por el banco. Erasto recibe una citación de la PTJ. Junior consuela a Rosa mientras Alejandro lucha por mantener su promesa de casarse con Rosalía.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: La familia Ferrandiz se encuentra muy conmovida por la muerte del Licenciado Finol, Leonardo, preocupado, decide ponerle seguridad a toda la familia, ya que está seguro de que la muerte de su compañero no fue un accidente, si no un atentado contra ellos. De esa manera busca incansablemente a Irene, que finalmente la encuentra con Felipe y le comenta que iniciará las acciones legales para anular su matrimonio. Agustina la escucha a Rebeca hablar con Adolfo sobre lo molesto que es Carlos Ernesto para su plan. Ella, preocupada, decide ir a la casa de Jimena y comentarle todos los problemas que hay en la casa de Leonardo, pero primero Carlos Ernesto le muestra unos papeles de las propiedades de Rebeca que fueron vendidas mientras ella estaba fallecida.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro lleva a Sol a una playa desierta y le confiesa su amor y ganas de estar con ella, pero Sol no le cree nada de lo que le dice. Heriberto se da cuenta de los planes de Alejandro y piensa que será él quien termine “jugando” con el. Carlos y Maricielo se encuentran en una plaza y se sinceran, confiesan su amor el uno por el otro. Pero saben que no pueden hacer lo que el corazón les dicta porque pesa la conciencia sobre sus cabezas, pensando que Alicia y Víctor Hugo son buenas personas.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Briggite y Junior totalmente tomados hablan casi sin entenderse de la película que va a filmar. Se besan y están juntos. Jesica sigue furiosa esperando a Junior pensando lo peor | que por su edad y la emoción de la película se haya muerto. Bienvenida le da ánimos a Graciela por lo que pasó con Anastasio. Gisela trata de averiguar con Armando quien es la joven por la cual se siente tan mal. Fabián y Finita tienen tremenda discusión por sexo. Wilker está cantando y lo está viendo Solymar.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Dileidy deja claro a Luis Fernando que, a pesar de su separación, no está disponible para él. Edén declara su amor a Pascuita. María Antonia echa a Paco de su casa. Gonzalo planea irse a vivir con Tatiana pero Paco estropea sus planes.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela y Ricardo disfrutan su reconciliación, mientras Celia ayuda a Moisés a esconderse de Néstor. Ricardo confronta a Celia por su embarazo, rechazando al bebé y negándole su apellido por amor a Manuela. Graciela descubre a Ricardo en casa de Celia y planea delatarlo. Por otro lado, Manuela descubre que está embarazada y celebra con su familia. Hortensia intenta alejar a Misael con dinero, y Moisés busca alejarse de Néstor para proteger su nueva vida.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Marisela grita a Adolfo todo el pasado con Consuelo delante de Junior y Andreína. René, Mariela y Mildred hacen colecta callejera para Carmen pero unos malandros se la roban. Eustoquio amenaza a Isaías por la estafa de los dólares. Adolfo reclama a Erasto por contarle todo a Marisela; Erasto lo expulsa. Natalia decide huir de Erasto y José Luis se ofrece a ayudarla. Rosalía enfrenta furiosa a Consuelo en la tienda exigiendo explicaciones sobre Adolfo. Carmen supera la crisis y Rosa logra verla en cuidados intensivos.

programme.desc: Manuela y Ricardo disfrutan su reconciliación, mientras Celia ayuda a Moisés a esconderse de Néstor. Ricardo confronta a Celia por su embarazo, rechazando al bebé y negándole su apellido por amor a Manuela. Graciela descubre a Ricardo en casa de Celia y planea delatarlo. Por otro lado, Manuela descubre que está embarazada y celebra con su familia. Hortensia intenta alejar a Misael con dinero, y Moisés busca alejarse de Néstor para proteger su nueva vida.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Marisela grita a Adolfo todo el pasado con Consuelo delante de Junior y Andreína. René, Mariela y Mildred hacen colecta callejera para Carmen pero unos malandros se la roban. Eustoquio amenaza a Isaías por la estafa de los dólares. Adolfo reclama a Erasto por contarle todo a Marisela; Erasto lo expulsa. Natalia decide huir de Erasto y José Luis se ofrece a ayudarla. Rosalía enfrenta furiosa a Consuelo en la tienda exigiendo explicaciones sobre Adolfo. Carmen supera la crisis y Rosa logra verla en cuidados intensivos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: La familia Ferrandiz se encuentra muy conmovida por la muerte del Licenciado Finol, Leonardo, preocupado, decide ponerle seguridad a toda la familia, ya que está seguro de que la muerte de su compañero no fue un accidente, si no un atentado contra ellos. De esa manera busca incansablemente a Irene, que finalmente la encuentra con Felipe y le comenta que iniciará las acciones legales para anular su matrimonio. Agustina la escucha a Rebeca hablar con Adolfo sobre lo molesto que es Carlos Ernesto para su plan. Ella, preocupada, decide ir a la casa de Jimena y comentarle todos los problemas que hay en la casa de Leonardo, pero primero Carlos Ernesto le muestra unos papeles de las propiedades de Rebeca que fueron vendidas mientras ella estaba fallecida.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro lleva a Sol a una playa desierta y le confiesa su amor y ganas de estar con ella, pero Sol no le cree nada de lo que le dice. Heriberto se da cuenta de los planes de Alejandro y piensa que será él quien termine “jugando” con el. Carlos y Maricielo se encuentran en una plaza y se sinceran, confiesan su amor el uno por el otro. Pero saben que no pueden hacer lo que el corazón les dicta porque pesa la conciencia sobre sus cabezas, pensando que Alicia y Víctor Hugo son buenas personas.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Briggite y Junior totalmente tomados hablan casi sin entenderse de la película que va a filmar. Se besan y están juntos. Jesica sigue furiosa esperando a Junior pensando lo peor | que por su edad y la emoción de la película se haya muerto. Bienvenida le da ánimos a Graciela por lo que pasó con Anastasio. Gisela trata de averiguar con Armando quien es la joven por la cual se siente tan mal. Fabián y Finita tienen tremenda discusión por sexo. Wilker está cantando y lo está viendo Solymar.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Dileidy deja claro a Luis Fernando que, a pesar de su separación, no está disponible para él. Edén declara su amor a Pascuita. María Antonia echa a Paco de su casa. Gonzalo planea irse a vivir con Tatiana pero Paco estropea sus planes.

Por otro lado, Manuela descubre que está embarazada y celebra con su familia. Hortensia intenta alejar a Misael con dinero, y Moisés busca alejarse de Néstor para proteger su nueva vida.

Eustoquio amenaza a Isaías por la estafa de los dólares. Adolfo reclama a Erasto por contarle todo a Marisela; Erasto lo expulsa. Natalia decide huir de Erasto y José Luis se ofrece a ayudarla. Rosalía enfrenta furiosa a Consuelo en la tienda exigiendo explicaciones sobre Adolfo. Carmen supera la crisis y Rosa logra verla en cuidados intensivos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra le pide a Tony que le ponga un aviso a la credencial de entrada a la empresa a Irene, por lo que cuando Irene se presentó a la empresa para poder cobrar su liquidación final Alejandra la cita en su oficina y la trata de una manera muy hiriente. Rebeca contrata a una nueva secretaria para Leonardo para que la mantenga informada sobre todos los movimientos de él en la empresa. María Lucía va a los tribunales para poder averiguar quién fue la persona que le pidió la prueba de paternidad. A no conseguir ninguna información se acerca a la casa de Zulay para pedirle que haga un esfuerzo y le diga el nombre de su verdadero padre. Adolfo, Rebeca y Rodrigo plantan una información falsa de que el atentado contra Juan Pablo que acabó con su muerte fue una maniobra armada por los Samora.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Alejandro están en la playa desierta, comienzan a besarse y se confiesan su amor. Luego se van al yate y se quedan ahí hasta que unos ladrones entran y golpean a Sol. Luego uno de ellos le dispara a quemarropa a Alejandro. Columba y Eloy van a hablar con Maricielo, quien les dice que no los perdona. Luego se encuentran con José Domingo y le dicen que tienen que hablar algo con él acerca de Maricielo pero José Domingo se pone ansioso, y Eloy y Columba parecen arrepentidos.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Durante Año Nuevo, Misha y Igor debaten sobre la moralidad de los criminales. Igor se acerca peligrosamente a descubrir la verdad sobre Kolya, quien logra escapar tras atacarlo, creyendo haberlo matado.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha descubre que Pavlik no es su hijo biológico y su solicitud de visa es rechazada. Kolya es víctima de un chantaje, mientras que Igor encuentra evidencia de los negocios ilícitos de Misha. Como represalia, los hombres de Pan secuestran a Margarita.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha engaña a Pan para salvar a Margarita y huye con su familia a un pueblo. Al empeorar Pavlik, deciden robar un avión para llegar a EE.UU., pero Misha es arrestado. Gracias al testimonio de Rita, queda libre, aunque ahora han sido delatados a las autoridades.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha y Kolya intentan recuperar el dinero que Pan les quitó, pero se enfrentan a un peligroso criminal. Mientras tanto, la salud de Pavlik empeora e Igor es reinstalado en su cargo para investigar el caso del "Francés".

programme.title: Jugar con fuego

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Lo que empieza como un cuento de hadas no siempre tiene un final feliz en la vida. La realidad es tal que a menudo el cuento de hadas de la vida termina con un final dramático. Los hechos tienen lugar en 1978. Una ingenua huérfana criada en un internado de provincias llega a la bulliciosa y concurrida capital. Sasha ya ha cumplido 18 años y necesita empezar una vida adulta e independiente. Una chica consigue un trabajo en la Casa de la Moda como limpiadora. Es aquí donde tiene que pasar de ser un felpudo discreto a un modelo famoso. Con el tiempo llegan a su vida hombres que le prestan todo tipo de atención. Tres hombres comienzan a cortejarla, todos ellos tratando de conquistar el corazón de Sasha: un artista de vanguardia llamado Iván, un vendedor ambulante llamado Vadim, que se ha criado en una familia muy respetable de la capital, y un mayor del KGB llamado Kim. ¡Pero Sasha ya ha elegido al hombre de sus sueños y para estar junto a él tendrá que pasar por un número increíble de pruebas!

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Sasha e Iván son felices, sin sospechar que han atraído la atención de Kim Olegovich, un mayor de la KGB y supervisor de la Casa de Modelos. Su objetivo es separarlos. Kim, sintiendo una atracción personal por Sasha, utiliza el chantaje y la manipulación para acercarse a ella. La relación entre Sasha e Iván comienza a desmoronarse ante sus ojos. Kim está a punto de lograr su propósito, pero entonces recibe una noticia inesperada: Sasha se va a casar. La noticia sacude no solo a Kim, sino también a toda la Casa de Modelos.

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: La vida de Sasha con un esposo al que no ama se vuelve insoportable. Pero en su camino hacia la felicidad con Iván aún se interpone Kim Olegovich. Atrapados y sin salida, los amantes toman una decisión desesperada…

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Al llegar a un acuerdo con Kim, Sasha abre el camino para su viaje a París. Iván, por su parte, planea emigrar a Israel con la intención de trasladarse después a Francia. La Casa de Modelos triunfa en sus desfiles en París, pero la estrella de la pasarela, Alexandra Linkova, está visiblemente nerviosa. Kim se da cuenta de que Sasha está planeando algo y no deja de vigilar cada uno de sus movimientos…

programme.desc: La salsa es un baile latinoamericano, cuya emoción y energía que desborda pueden derretir hasta la nieve de Rusia. No es de extrañar que en el ambiente de la salsa se sientan atraídas personas completamente diferentes que quieren cambiar algo en sus vidas, llenarlas de sentido y de colores nuevos. En la salsa puedes darte cuenta de todo, porque cada baile es una pequeña historia de amor. Irina Kanevskaya también cae bajo el encanto de la salsa. Ella es jefa de un departamento bancario, con una carrera exitosa, pero desde hace tiempo se encuentra sentada en su aburrido trabajo y ha perdido el gusto por la vida. Pero un encuentro inesperado con Igor Samoilov, un bailarín de salsa experimentado, provoca un cambio radical en su forma de vivir.

programme.title: Moda Creativa: Estilo Hecho a Mano y Sostenible

programme.title: Trucos caseros geniales y mejoras DIY que te encantarán
programme.desc: Desde consejos ingeniosos para el dormitorio y el baño hasta decoraciones hechas a mano y muebles económicos, estas ideas transformarán tu hogar. ¡Descubre trucos inteligentes y proyectos creativos que harán tu vida más fácil y elegante!

programme.title: Diseñando Belleza: Creación de Piezas de Joyería Personalizadas
programme.desc: Explora el arte de la joyería, donde la creatividad y la artesanía se unen. Perfecto para aquellos que aman diseñar y llevar piezas únicas y personalizadas.

programme.title: Cortar a tajos ¡te va a encantar!

programme.title: Trucos Creativos para Reciclar Plástico
programme.desc: Descubra formas innovadoras de transformar desechos plásticos en artículos funcionales y elegantes, desde chaquetas hechas de bolsas de plástico viejas hasta protectores de bicicleta únicos. Estos trucos de reciclaje no solo ayudan a reducir desechos, sino que también convierten la basura en tesoros, ¡demostrando que la creatividad puede llevar a un futuro sostenible!

programme.title: Arte Sostenible: La Belleza de la Producción Natural

There, students will bond with a unicorn to unlock the steed's magical powers, and hone their riding skills to become revered protectors of the island and its magic. Riding classes, magic classes, unicorn care and groom classes - Unicorn Academy is the boarding school of every kid's dreams. Together with their unicorns, they must all work together when an evil villain, RAVENZELLA, breaks out of her magic prison and uses her powerful grim magic to exact revenge on the Academy.
